look: an aedelf man, a dark elf with deep indigo-violet skin, a long wild mane of silver-white hair, long pointed ears and a lean muscular build
dome: cap of long wild silver-white hair
torso_tilt: first the top plane of the chest with its two pectoral muscles meeting at the breastbone, then, tucked under the chest, a short glimpse of the flat upper belly.
torso_paint: the torso as one athletic chest with two pectoral muscles and a flat upper belly below them
face_paint: the head as a cap of long silver-white hair seen from above, parted down the middle and combed outward in long flowing strands, with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural dark elf face strongly foreshortened from above, calm white brows over shadowed eyes, a nose tip, closed lips and the front of the chin
arms_paint: firm shoulders and collarbones across the shoulder band; level arms with lean, lightly defined muscle

hair_long.paint: the hair on the shoulders as long loose wavy silver-white strands fanning outward from the parting, seen from above, its edge ending in soft uneven tips along the sculpt's outline

ear_spike.label: face
ear_spike.guide: A long pointed ear rises out of the hair on each side of the head, its tip pointing outward and back.
ear_spike.paint: each ear as a long slim pointed violet ear standing clear of the hair

notes: head-size rule: the legacy head frame (0.224 of the half span) is a circle on the hair mass; skull built at 0.150, hair cap x1.50
face_tilt: the fringe of the hair, right under it the brow shading the eye sockets into two dark slits, then the bridge and tip of the nose, and just behind the nose the lips and the front of the chin. Brow, nose tip and chin sit close together, squeezed by the steep view, and the chin is the bottom edge of the head, with the chest starting directly below it.
